snippet.title: Super POSTAL (2000) PC - Full Walkthrough (Japan Levels) - (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
In 2000 a Japanese version of Postal called Super Postal was released featuring Japanese voices and two exclusive levels, "Tokyo" and "Osaka". These levels remained exclusive to Super Postal until the release of Postal Redux in 2016.

Super POSTAL or POSTAL Power-Up Kit (パワーアップキット Pawāappukitto) is the localized Japanese version of POSTAL. 

Made specifically for the Japanese market, this version of POSTAL features a complete Japanese dub and two extra levels: Akihabara and Dōtonbori (more commonly known as Tokyo and Osaka to English speakers).

POSTAL is available on Steam for FREE with the expansion levels also included.

Initial release date: March 17th, 2000

Developer: Running with Scissors

Platforms: Windows, Mac OS, Linux

(Recorded on PC on Steam) 

00:08 Tokyo
10:11 Osaka
